input.task: Confirm that this page quotes J.K. Rowling.

provenance: the same plan and the same site as live-quotes-js-text-tier-reaches, one URL apart: /js-delayed/ renders the identical content ~10s after load. Measured 2026-08-19: after `navigate()` (domcontentloaded plus a bounded 2s wait for `load`, ADR-007) the body is 78 characters — chrome only — against 1,499 on /js/. So the agent stops loudly at failure:locate, correctly classified, with no answer invented. This is the live twin of the render-delayed mutation (l4-shop-render-delayed) and it is what makes that fixture mutation more than a thought experiment: 10s of injected delay in the fixture, ~10s of real delay here, the same stop.

triage.note: passing = the correct classification, not the answer. support-matrix D6 declares the underlying gap: `resolve()` counts matches once with no wait, so late content is indistinguishable from absent content. If a bounded first-tier wait ever lands, this case's expectation flips to success in the same change — the same eval-first pattern as l4-shop-button-text-renamed.
